## Core Question

How can a probabilistic model classify genomic regions?

## Lesson Scaffold

- Introduce CpG biological motivation.
- Compare island and background Markov models.
- Define a log-likelihood ratio classifier.
- Discuss thresholds, sensitivity, and specificity.
- Name training bias and genome-specific composition as failure modes.
